bounded_question: When a gene is absent, inactive, or apparently dispensable, what supplies the biochemical function?
count_unit: Distinct gene/function allocation questions. Multiple ortholog donors, complex members and multiple papers supporting one question do not add cases. BioG and BioK are separate candidate-family questions with different verification bounds.
excluded_prior_cases: QueF nitrile reductase prior context case

queH_2017.inspection: Complete main Results/Discussion and Methods; Figures 1–4 descriptions and complementation constructs; supporting files not inspected.

retrieval_notes: Europe PMC fullTextXML returned HTTP 500 for several nonretrieved XML records; PMC HTML with ?report=xml subsequently supplied those main texts. This is an access issue, not a biological absence.
Bare PMC HTML for some entries returned a browser-check page (~21 KB); those files remain raw retrieval artifacts and were not used as article text. Alternate HTML is explicitly saved.
Direct Wiley urllib retrieval returned HTTP 403; the publisher full-text record was read with the web tool and saved as raw/LysU-2017-web-record.json.
PMC204760, PMC206834 and PMC209130 text is abstract plus scanned-page links; source inspection bounds reflect this.
probes.skill_use_bounds: Research router used for source selection; RCSB core API called through the skill script. Full-text retrieval used Europe PMC and PMC article HTML. An early direct PMC OA-service availability attempt failed and supplied no evidence; its narrow skill wrapper was not used, so no PMC-skill retrieval is claimed. No extra agents spawned.

scope_limitations: Published outcomes were known; choice chains are retrospective reconstruction, not blinded discovery.
No native gene absence was inferred from a failed lookup, and no normal physiological role was inferred from complementation alone.
No repository files, design, execution behavior or tests were changed; all saved files are research artifacts under this directory.
No thought-pattern taxonomy, process slots or scoring axes are proposed.

All biological experiments are the authors’ work. Actual independent work comprises the prior coordinate calculation and the new bounded route-bookkeeping/growth arithmetic; no kinetic/flux model or native condition was invented.
case_deep_trace_flag_scope: cases.jsonl deep_trace flags preserve the initial intake snapshot. Current detailed coverage is the four case IDs in detailed_traces.json; no case record was rewritten.

research_updates.request: Test same-reaction replacement versus bypass/changed demand using existing BioZ and ThyX cases.
research_updates.actual_work: One reproducible arithmetic probe: acyl-carbon and reduction-event accounting, projected folate reaction addition, assay amount/volume conversion and reported-growth-rate conversion.
research_updates.not_done: No new browsing, biological experiments, flux/model fitting, supplementary model execution, repository edits, central-table edits or additional agents.
research_updates.donor_compatibility_limit: Preserved separately: BioZ condensation Results mention NADH; coupled DTB Methods supply NADPH. Canonical-route exclusive donor allocation is not inferred. ThyX/ThyA-FolA projected net identity is conditional on the same donor.
